## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] New user-facing texts added to every file in `locales/`
- [ ] `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` updated if users will notice the change
- [ ] No real API keys or personal data in code, fixtures or screenshots
